residual_risks: The 432-item upstream suite is reduced to 25 deterministic child-side JSON scenarios; live sockets, DTLS, callbacks, host CA paths, current-time validity, random output, and private CFFI pointers are explicitly outside the contract.
The Oracle solve script fetches only the exact frozen GitHub revision and validates the archive digest; the model Agent remains no-network with an empty static allowlist.
The call-hang control is bounded by the configured candidate total timeout and returned 25 collected failures after about 352 seconds.
